About the Marathon Elite

The Marathon Elite is our race-day road shoe. A full-length carbon plate sits between two layers of high-rebound foam, giving a stiff, propulsive ride that rewards a high cadence. The ultralight knit upper weighs almost nothing and is held in place by a minimal heel counter. At 198 grams in a UK 8 it is the lightest shoe we make. It is a specialist tool: the foam compresses faster than a daily trainer, so expect around 400 kilometres of racing and fast sessions rather than 800 kilometres of easy mileage. It is not waterproof. For everyday running the Velocity X9 is the better choice.

Frequently asked questions

How does the Marathon Elite fit?

True to size for most runners. If you are between sizes, take the larger size: the toe box is snug at the front.

How long do these shoes last?

Between 600 and 800 kilometres of road running, depending on your weight and surface.

What is the return window?

30 days from delivery, free, on unworn shoes in the original box. See the returns policy.
